title: OpenClaw for Product Managers: 7 Workflows That Run Without You
summary: Product managers spend 30% of their week on tasks an AI agent can handle. Here are 7 OpenClaw workflows that automate feedback synthesis, sprint prep, and reporting.
body_markdown: Zapier and Make run if-then triggers between specific tool integrations. OpenClaw agents reason and adapt — they can read a messy transcript and extract themes, interpret ambiguous feedback, write in your company's voice, and handle tasks that require judgment. For synthesis, drafting, and multi-source analysis, OpenClaw does what Zapier cannot.
